protocol.hierarchy_priority: For each budget independently, branches are ordered by maximum leaf score and expanded until their union covers the budget. The shared leaf scorer ranks that candidate union; the global order fills only uncovered capacity.
protocol.matched_retention: Every cell retains exactly min(budget, scene view count) records.
protocol.raw_construction_boundary: Raw RGB-D clusters were frozen before manual zones were read. Lexical and BGE cells use ViewJSON text only as a shared query-time leaf scorer, not as a raw-construction input.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired 10,000-resample bootstrap differences against the manual hierarchy for every non-manual cell.
